description: Make production Firebase Auth primary, constrain local demos to explicit @educrm.demo accounts, map auth errors safely, and verify real registration/login behavior.
steps: Set the local/production demo flags deliberately and update firebase/config.ts/AuthContext/StudentOnboardingGuard/Login/Register so production ignores demo sessions while local explicit demo sessions remain non-fatal when Firebase sync fails.
Add a centralized Firebase auth error mapper and replace raw Login/Register error rendering/logging with safe user-facing messages, especially auth/invalid-credential.

Add unit and E2E coverage for error mapping, explicit demos, verification routing, logout/session behavior, and a credential-gated real registration → logout → login runtime path. Document provider/domain checks that require Firebase Console access.
acceptance_criteria: Production builds use VITE_DEMO_MODE=false and real email/password Firebase Auth for normal accounts.
Only known explicit @educrm.demo identities use local demo access, and demo sync failures never show as credential errors.
auth/invalid-credential is mapped to a clear message without exposing raw Firebase text, passwords, tokens, or credential objects.
Real student registration creates an Auth user, preserves email verification, and supports logout then login when Firebase configuration is valid.

implemented: VITE_DEMO_MODE is now parsed strictly as true; the local .env remains true for explicit demos and .env.production is false for hosted production Firebase Auth.
Demo identities are centralized in src/utils/demoAccounts.ts. Unknown @educrm.demo addresses now use Firebase Auth and cannot fall back to a local role.
Demo login no longer attempts fake Firebase credentials. Best-effort Firestore profile sync remains non-fatal to the local session.
AuthContext, StudentOnboardingGuard, ProtectedLayout, and RoleGate ignore stored demo sessions when demo mode is disabled and accept only known demo identities when enabled.
Login and Register now use src/utils/firebaseAuthErrors.ts. auth/invalid-credential and unknown Firebase errors render safe messages without raw Firebase error text.
consoleFollowUps: In Firebase Console, confirm Authentication > Sign-in method has Email/Password enabled for the production project.
In Firebase Console, confirm education-crm-9fee2.web.app and the actual production host are authorized domains; add localhost only for local testing.
Verify the production email verification template/action URL returns to /verify-email and inspect provider email delivery limits.
Run the gated real registration → verification → logout → login path with a disposable environment-provided account after the provider/domain checks pass.
evidence: src/utils/firebaseAuthErrors.test.ts covers invalid credentials, registration/network errors, and unknown-error fallback.

src/utils/demoAccounts.test.ts and tests/e2e/auth.spec.ts cover explicit demo identities, rejected unknown demo-looking identities, safe auth errors, session persistence, logout, and the credential-gated real path.
tests/e2e/student-workflow.spec.ts now uses the explicit registered demo identity instead of a non-demo email fixture.

blocked_reason: Real credential-gated verification and Firebase Console provider/domain checks remain pending environment/Console access. Full E2E also has unrelated pre-existing failures noted in verification.
notes: No secrets, passwords, tokens, or credential objects were added to tests, logs, feature evidence, or user-facing auth errors. No hosting deployment or push was performed from this step.
